{{Quote|Why are the Jedi unable to serve as a military?''"<br />"''The Jedi are not an army, and they number too few, in any case. They intercede at our request, but also at their own discretion. Furthermore, the Order has seen more deaths in the past twelve years than it saw in the previous fifty.|The Ord Mantell senator and Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] '''senator''' represented the<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]]. During a session of the Galactic Senate that took place in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Rotunda]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] involving a discussion about raising a military force, the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] asked why the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was not able to function as a military. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] turned to him and replied that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were not an [[Army/Legends|army]], were few in number, and were not completely under the control of the Senate.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The senator appeared in [[James Luceno]]'s novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], published in [[2012]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
